gloss: (formal/humble) presenting a gift to a superior

definitions.gloss: (formal/humble) presenting a gift to a superior; offering something to a person of higher status
definitions.explanation: (formal/humble) presenting a gift to a superior; offering something to a person of higher status

examples.japanese: お{茶|ちゃ}を{進上|しんじょう}いたします。
examples.english: I humbly present this tea to you.

examples.japanese: {殿様|とのさま}に{名産品|めいさんひん}を{進上|しんじょう}した。
examples.english: Local specialties were presented to the lord.

examples.japanese: {菓子折|かしおり}りの{熨斗|のし}{紙|がみ}に「{進上|しんじょう}」と{書|か}かれていた。
examples.english: The gift wrapping paper on the box of sweets was inscribed with 'shinjo' (presented with respect).

notes:
A humble term for presenting something to a social superior, composed of {進|しん} (to advance/present) and {上|じょう} (upward/to a superior). Historically used when offering goods or gifts to nobility, feudal lords, or the emperor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進上|しんじょう}いたす — to humbly present (humble verb form)
- {進上|しんじょう}{品|ひん} — a presented gift
- {進上|しんじょう}���る — to present to a superior

USAGE:
In modern Japanese, {進上|しんじょう} survives mainly on the {熨斗|のし}{紙|がみ} (formal gift wrapping paper) used for traditional gift-giving. It appears as a printed label on gifts presented to superiors or on formal occasions. The word is otherwise archaic in everyday conversation.
